description:
Use this when the user's screen needs OR logic, arithmetic between two metrics or a screen expression that screen_stocks filters cannot express.

Returns matching securities, 25 a page by default, with identity and core valuation columns and the metrics the query names; name any other metric you want returned in `columns`. `query` is one expression of metric names, numbers, = != > < >= <=, AND, OR, brackets, + - * / and the functions COALESCE, IF, LEAST, POWER, ABS, SQRT and LOG, for example `Return on capital employed > 22% AND (Debt to equity < 0.5 OR Interest Coverage Ratio > 8)`. It has no text values: restrict by sector, industry, igroup, isubgroup, company_type or index with `scope`, an object such as {"index": "NIFTY 50"}; a name that is not recognised is refused with the closest valid names. `dialect` is "screener" (default: common screener names, percentages written as 22%, market cap in crore) or "dalalos" (DalalOS metric ids in stored units: fractions and rupees). An unknown metric name is an error, never a guess. A comparison with a missing value does not match; wrap the metric in COALESCE to give it a default. `limit` is 1 to 100 and `offset` at most 5000. Pass `pagination.snapshot_id` from the first page as `snapshot_id` on later pages, and start again from `offset` 0 if a call returns `snapshot_expired`. `definitions` adds named ratios to use in the query.

include_column_scales.description: true adds the minimum, maximum and 5th and 95th percentile of each numeric column across all matches.
include_column_scales.title: Include Column Scales

include_condition_counts.description: true adds `condition_counts`: for each AND-ed condition, how many companies pass it and how many fail only it.
include_condition_counts.title: Include Condition Counts

include_row_context.description: true adds to each row its 52-week low and high and the dates of the filings behind it.
include_row_context.title: Include Row Context

only_failing_condition.description: 0-based index of a condition in `condition_counts`: returns the companies that fail only that condition.
only_failing_condition.title: Only Failing Condition

only_latest_results.description: true keeps only companies that have filed results for the latest quarter most companies have reported.
only_latest_results.title: Only Latest Results

query.description: One boolean expression over metric names, e.g. "Market Capitalization > 5000 AND Return on capital employed > 20%" in the default screener dialect.
query.title: Query

sort_by.description: Metric id to sort by. Default market_cap.
sort_by.title: Sort By

name: screen_by_query
title: Screener query
